pages.text: The river was too high to cross on foot. Reaching the market across it meant taking a boat. People lined up at the landing.
Sonu tugged Mom toward the boat. "I want to cross, too!" But it was full of people.
Mom said, "Let's take the next one." Sonu stamped their feet.
Sonu flopped onto the sand. "I'm getting on now!"
Mina pulled Sonu's arm. Sonu resisted and would not get up.
The next boat arrived. Mom waved it on.
The boat grew smaller on the river. Sonu still lay there.
Mina sat beside them, too. "I want to get on soon, too. Let's take the next boat together."
Sonu jumped up and boarded the third boat. Three hands held its side together.
